reviews.title: Quality and features
reviews.comment: Hello,  Thank you for fast delivery.  I cannot image that this PSU has USB FAN HUB and also 90 DEGREE AC. This is an awesome feature that i needed for my build.  My previous psu does not work and this will be used for my new build.  It comes with a rotational  ac which is a nice feature depending where i am going to install and also the USB hub.  I do not need to buy an extra USB hub as i always needed to have extra USB beacuse motherboard internal ports are enot enough and with this hub , i do have option to separate and use it like normal usb hub or i can connect on the psu as another internal hub. Awesome feature.  This PSU is rated gold ,which is more than enough for my build .  With awesome cables that comes with it, i do not need to order customs cable as these are eenough.  I will give 5 star as LIAN LI is reputable company and i have used previous PSU from them as well as this RS1200W that i just got.  Thank you LIAN LI for awesome product

reviews.title: Innovative tech, and a powerful new upgrade
reviews.comment: The Lian Li RS1200G 1200W Rotational Shift Fully Modular ATX Power Supply is the latest addition to the collection of tech for my new PC build. While I'd have preferred the white color option (to match my build), the novel innovation of the rotatable AC inlet offers a level of versatility that I've never seen in any power supply before. As we add more and more components to our tech over time, a power supply such as this allows us to ramp up as our system needs grow. This is a real upgrade for me, and I'm pleased to be on the cutting edge with this amazing piece of tech. I can't wait to see what they come up with next! Highly recommended.
reviews.author: EverNoticeThat

reviews.title: not worth the price
reviews.comment: While the product is somewhat innovative, its performance and user experience don’t justify the price. It’s about one-third more expensive than similar products, so I don’t recommend it.
reviews.author: Derek

reviews.title: A Power Supply To Run Everything
reviews.comment: This is a beast of a power supply. I have the 1200W model, and I've seen 1000W people having trouble with it and saying the cords aren't great. However, the 1200W model's cords seem perfectly fine, and I haven't had any issues with the quality. I like that this lets you flip the power port around based on your case, but I feel like that's never really been a huge issue for me in the past. However, I love multifunction. It does help that this is Fully Modular and easy to get all the cords, along with add-on ports for other devices. The noise level is about average with what you'd expect of a power supply. This is something that will definitely be able to run anything you want to throw at it. I've started using Lian Li porducts awhile back and so far they have worked out great!
reviews.author: Garrett Thomas

reviews.title: Epic PSU
reviews.comment: This is epic. Well more than enough power for my setup, even lets me run two GPU's at once without any issues. Great brand with a solid warranty. This one is interesting because you can mount it in different cases without having to worry about which side your plug goes to. Runs great, nice and quiet, doesn't add any heat to the build either. Really like the modular design, keeps the case clean and tidy.
